critical_code_review_comments: App.js Zeile 1077: isFullScreenStaffMgr variable correctly added and used in both showBottomNav (line 1078) and CookieBanner gate (line 1155). Clean, idiomatic fix.

Composer z-[70] in StaffChat.jsx is a pragmatic z-index escalation to defeat BottomNav/CookieBanner overlap on fragments of the route — the root fix (hiding both on this route) is the structural one; the z-[70] is belt-and-suspenders. Acceptable.

Consider extracting 'fullscreen routes' into a centralized constant array (e.g., FULLSCREEN_ROUTES = ['/merchant/staff/chat']) so future additions don't require touching three boolean checks in App.js.

rca of the issue: ORIGINAL BUG (iter111): When Manager clicked chat-send-btn at /merchant/staff/chat, the BottomNav (bottom-fixed) and the CookieBanner (bottom-fixed with higher z-index) were stacked over the composer area. The actual click was being intercepted by an underlying nav element (most likely BottomNav's 'mehr' or 'wallet' link in the same x-coordinate as the composer's send-btn at the bottom of the viewport), which routed the SPA to /account or /more. RESOLUTION: (1) Added isFullScreenStaffMgr = currentPath === '/merchant/staff/chat' in App.js (line 1077). (2) Excluded BottomNav rendering for this route (line 1078). (3) Excluded CookieBanner rendering for this route (line 1155). (4) Hardened the composer with z-[70] in StaffChat.jsx as defensive depth. REPRODUCTION (post-fix, on preview URL): login as haendler, GOTO /merchant/staff/chat, click first thread, type any text, click chat-send-btn — observe URL stays, bubble appears. CONFIRMED via Playwright: nav_log during send = [] (zero unwanted navs).
